claim_boundary: Evidence integrity and native mechanism qualification pass. Structural all-flow and convergent-all-seed research gates fail. This does not assert all blockers closed or general memory-system qualification.

owner_admission_limits: Real trained IntegerBitCell executes through NeuronModelPort and NeuronRuntime with durable SparseJournal and separate FileAnchorWitnessStore in two fresh processes per seed.
Calibration is intentionally inactive: every native signal abstains and no serving or learning.artifact publication authority is granted.
Only the original three-crate dependency closure is compiled; this is not full-workspace product admission.
Live revocation-frontier freshness remains the registry/owner responsibility and is outside this native artifact bridge.
Queries recall 64 facts written during training; this is not unseen-fact generalization or a universal compression result.

Each deployed artifact is 1128 bytes (1104 weight bytes plus 24 header); 64 eight-bit target values alone are 64 bytes. Query representation, writer facts, durable owner state and build evidence are additional state.

native.qualification_scope: actual three-crate NeuronRuntime qualification; no full-workspace or production admission claim

audit_limitations: SVD/reconstruction work and retained bytes are recomputed from saved artifacts and logs.
Aggregate diagnostic counters are checked in sums; clustering is not rerun and diagnostic operations were not individually traced.
Historical elapsed times and floating-point prequantization SVD errors cannot be independently remeasured by a read-only audit.
structure.consolidation_scope: Accepted consolidation reuses the current write's freshly trained and charged global SVD base; it is a real replacement model. No additional fictitious consolidation fit is counted.

convergent_seed_331_failure.interpretation: Seed 331 chose the feasible raw split. Energy and later split proposals could not fund all retention minima under 4096 bytes. The second write really consolidated to one cell but did not erase first-stage quality/work loss. Relative retention floors can pass while absolute domain error remains high.

structure.count_scope: Counts are actual execution events over 20 seed-flow cases / 25 episodes. Heterogeneous data are repeated as episode 0 of corresponding convergent flows; these are separate executed fits, not independent datasets.

development_comparison.interpretation: Frozen integrated development passed 2/2 convergent cases; the independent formal five seeds passed 4/5, so the all-seed convergent gate fails. Development success is not out-of-sample qualification.

structure.historical_v2_gate: unchanged historical failure: 2/5 structural wins; this new family/protocol does not overwrite it
structure.merge_scope: Ten pair-merge decisions were skipped by the already-fitted-global retention check; zero pair-merge candidate bases were trained and zero pair merges were adopted. Five many-to-one consolidations were adopted separately.

metric_definitions.fixed_selection: Strongest fixed count among 1,2,4 uses entire-flow selection hindsight; no hidden read values select it. Routing and rank allocation may relearn per write.
metric_definitions.flow_hidden_mse: Arithmetic mean of episode hidden MSE, as frozen; flow summary then averages all five seeds, including seed 331.
metric_definitions.literal_relative_mse_gain: Diagnostic only: (fixed_MSE - adaptive_MSE)/fixed_MSE; not substituted into the frozen strict gate.
metric_definitions.normalized_gain: (fixed_MSE - adaptive_MSE) / max(fixed_MSE, 1.0); when fixed MSE < 1 this is not an ordinary percentage reduction.
metric_definitions.priced_regret: Adaptive priced loss minus named fixed priced loss; negative favors adaptive under declared prices.
metric_definitions.strict_gate: At least .05 normalized quality gain vs both efficient natural and matched-work fixed, lower priced loss than both, and selection-domain retention floors.
metric_definitions.work_unit: SVD shape proxy plus reconstruction/diagnostic multiply counts; not measured hardware FLOPs, currency, or hardware-independent net-benefit proof.
